messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: example vol3/camel segmentation fault
parts:
This example deals with bivariate normal with missing data.
It looks like the error might happen here:

derived parameters {
vector(2) Y[12];
Y[1, 1] <- 1;
Y[1, 2] <- 1;
......
}

with generated cpp code

// derived variables
vector<vector_v> Y(12);
Y[1- 1][1- 1] = 1;
Y[1- 1][2- 1] = 1;
Y[2- 1][1- 1] = 1;

--
Jiqiang

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] example vol3/camel segmentation fault
parts:
Thanks for the detective work.

You put your finger right on the problem.
The variable declaration being generated
should be:

vector<vector_v> Y(12,vector_v(2));

I'll fix it and follow-up with mail to the
list when I commit a patch.

- Bob
